_comment: Template for gamedesigner-thermite-facilitator sub-agent output format v2.0

sessionInfo.topic: Core gameplay systems and design pillars

designDecisions.title: Short descriptive decision title
designDecisions.context: Why this decision arose and why it matters (1-2 paragraphs)
designDecisions.decision: Clear statement of what was decided

alternativesConsidered.whyRejected: Reason this option was not chosen

dissent.concern: Their specific concern about the decision
dissent.resolution: How the concern was addressed or acknowledged

validationNeeded: What needs to be tested/prototyped to confirm this works

blocks: What this decision enables (e.g., DEC-002, feat-001)

openQuestions.question: Unresolved design question requiring further exploration
openQuestions.owner: Persona name responsible for this domain
blockerFor: What this question blocks (features, decisions, systems)
openQuestions.suggestedInvestigation: Recommended approach to answering this question

designPillars.name: Meaningful Risk
designPillars.description: Every action matters. Gear has weight. Victories feel earned because defeat has consequences.
guardrails: No insurance that always returns everything
Death must sting, but not devastate progression
designPillars.kpi: Metric or observation to measure if pillar is being met

coreMechanics.name: Grid-Based Movement
coreMechanics.description: How the mechanic works in detail
riskFactors: Potential exploits or balance issues to watch

tensionsExplored.resolution: How the team resolved or balanced this tension

keyInsights: Major learning or realization from the design session
Strategic insight about the project direction

actionItems.task: Specific action to take based on session
dependencies: Other tasks or decisions this depends on

artifactsToCreate.docs/design/session_001_topic.md: Detailed session notes with discussion flow and decisions
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/decision_log.md: Chronological log of all design decisions with full context
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/gdd.md: Main GDD summary indexing all design work
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/economy_model.md: Currency faucets/sinks, progression curves, exploit analysis
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/map_templates.md: Map layouts, zones, loot distribution, flow analysis
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/gear_registry.md: All items with stats, counterplay, skill expression
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/visual_language.md: Visual design principles, color coding, audio cues
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/tech_spec.md: Technical architecture, netcode approach, performance targets
artifactsToCreate.docs/design/mvd_checklist.md: Minimum Viable Design checklist for prototype readiness

nextSession.topic: Recommended focus for next Thermite session
nextSession.reason: Why this topic should be explored next
preparationNeeded: Research or prototyping needed before session
